name: Shared UI Components
description: Reusable React components used across all documentation pages: Sidebar (persistent navigation with NavLink active highlighting for all 13 routes), CodeBlock (prism-react-renderer syntax highlighting with copy-to-clipboard button), VersionBadge (Tailwind pill badge for version strings), VideoEmbed (responsive 16:9 YouTube iframe), PageLayout (Sidebar + content area shell responsive to 768px), and CalloutBox (color-coded gotcha/warning/tip callouts). All components exported as named + default. Each has a vitest smoke test. Types re-export RouteEntry/RouteManifest from app_routing for consumer convenience.

functions.name: CalloutBox
functions.description: React component that renders a callout box with color-coded border and icon based on CalloutType. 'gotcha' renders red/error styling, 'warning' renders amber/caution styling, 'tip' renders green/info styling. Exported as named + default from CalloutBox.tsx.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing type, optional title, and children.

error_cases.name: invalid_callout_type
error_cases.condition: props.type is not one of the three valid CalloutType variants
error_cases.error_type: TypeScript compile error or runtime mismatch

postconditions: Returned element contains a container div with border color matching props.type
If props.title is provided and non-empty, a heading element is rendered with that text
props.children is rendered inside the callout body area
An icon element is rendered matching the callout type

structured_side_effects.description: Pure render function — no side effects beyond DOM output

functions.name: CodeBlock
functions.description: React component that wraps prism-react-renderer to display code/CLI commands with syntax highlighting. Includes a copy-to-clipboard button that invokes navigator.clipboard.writeText(props.code). Language defaults to 'bash'. Exported as named + default from CodeBlock.tsx.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing code string, optional language, and optional title.

preconditions: navigator.clipboard API is available in the browser environment (graceful degradation if not)
postconditions: Code text is rendered with prism-react-renderer syntax highlighting
A button element with accessible label (e.g. 'Copy' or copy icon) is present in the DOM
Clicking the copy button calls navigator.clipboard.writeText with the exact props.code value
If props.language is omitted, 'bash' is used as the Prism language
If props.title is provided, it is rendered above the code block

structured_side_effects.description: Copy button click writes props.code to system clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText

performance_budget.complexity: O(n) where n = code string length

functions.name: VersionBadge
functions.description: React component that displays a version string inside a styled Tailwind pill badge (rounded-full, px/py padding, bg/text color). Exported as named + default from VersionBadge.tsx.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing version string and optional className.

postconditions: A span or inline element is rendered with Tailwind pill classes (rounded-full, inline-flex or similar)
The text content of the badge is exactly props.version
If props.className is provided, those classes are merged onto the badge element

functions.name: VideoEmbed
functions.description: React component that renders a responsive YouTube iframe with aspect-video (16:9) styling. The iframe src is set from the provided URL. Exported as named + default from VideoEmbed.tsx.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing YouTube URL and optional title.

error_cases.name: invalid_youtube_url
error_cases.condition: props.url does not match the YouTube URL regex pattern

preconditions: props.url matches a valid YouTube embed or watch URL pattern
postconditions: An iframe element is rendered with src derived from props.url
The iframe container has Tailwind aspect-video class for responsive 16:9 ratio
The iframe title attribute is set to props.title (default 'Video')
The iframe includes allow='accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture' and allowFullScreen

structured_side_effects.description: Iframe triggers browser network request to YouTube to load video player. This is a browser-level side effect, not a component-level fetch.

functions.name: Sidebar
functions.description: React component that renders a persistent navigation sidebar. Iterates over the RouteManifest and creates a react-router-dom NavLink for each RouteEntry, with active route highlighting via NavLink's className callback. Wrapped in a semantic <nav> element. Exported as named + default from Sidebar.tsx.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing routes array and optional className.

error_cases.name: no_router_context
error_cases.condition: Sidebar is rendered outside of a Router provider
error_cases.error_type: React runtime error from react-router-dom: useLocation/useMatch called outside Router

preconditions: props.routes is a non-empty array of RouteEntry objects
Component is rendered within a react-router-dom Router context (BrowserRouter, MemoryRouter, etc.)
postconditions: A <nav> element is rendered as the root container
Exactly props.routes.length NavLink elements are rendered
Each NavLink 'to' attribute matches the corresponding RouteEntry.path
Each NavLink text content matches the corresponding RouteEntry.label
The NavLink for the currently active route receives active styling (distinct className or aria-current)
If props.className is provided, it is applied to the <nav> element

structured_side_effects.description: Pure render function — NavLink click navigation is handled by react-router-dom, not by this component

functions.name: PageLayout
functions.description: Shell component that composes Sidebar and a content area in a flex layout. At md: (768px+) breakpoint, sidebar is visible as a fixed-width column; below 768px, layout adapts (sidebar collapses or stacks). Exported as named + default from PageLayout.tsx.

inputs.name: props
inputs.description: Component props containing routes (passed to Sidebar) and children (page content).

error_cases.name: no_router_context
error_cases.condition: PageLayout is rendered outside of a Router provider (propagated from Sidebar)

preconditions: props.routes is a non-empty array of RouteEntry objects
Component is rendered within a react-router-dom Router context
postconditions: A flex container div is rendered as the root element
Sidebar component is rendered as a child, receiving props.routes
props.children is rendered in a main content area element (<main> or content div)
Layout uses Tailwind responsive classes: flex-col below md:, flex-row at md: and above
Content area occupies remaining horizontal space (flex-1 or equivalent)

structured_side_effects.description: Pure composition component — delegates side effects to Sidebar child

invariants: All six components (CalloutBox, CodeBlock, VersionBadge, VideoEmbed, Sidebar, PageLayout) are exported as both named and default exports from their respective .tsx files
Every .tsx file begins with 'import React from "react"'
index.ts barrel re-exports all types from types.ts and all named component exports from their respective files
RouteEntry and RouteManifest are NEVER redefined in this component — always imported from app_routing and re-exported
CalloutType variants are exactly 'gotcha', 'warning', 'tip' in lowercase — no other values accepted
CodeBlock language prop defaults to 'bash' when omitted
VideoEmbed container uses Tailwind 'aspect-video' class for 16:9 responsive ratio
Sidebar renders exactly one NavLink per RouteEntry in the provided routes array
PageLayout responsive breakpoint is md: (768px) — flex-col below, flex-row at and above
No file in this component exceeds 300 lines
Composition over inheritance: no class-based components, no component inheritance chains
All component tests are runnable in vitest jsdom environment with no external services
Sidebar and PageLayout tests must wrap rendered components in MemoryRouter
CodeBlock copy button test must mock navigator.clipboard.writeText

data_access.rationale: Components read PUBLIC data only: route manifest entries (slug, label, path) for navigation rendering, version strings for badge display, YouTube URLs for iframe embedding, and CLI command strings for syntax-highlighted code blocks. No PII, no INTERNAL data, no persistent writes.

side_effects.rationale: CodeBlock copy button invokes navigator.clipboard.writeText with the code string passed via props — a user-initiated side effect writing PUBLIC CLI command text to the system clipboard.
All six components render PUBLIC content into the DOM via React. No sensitive data is rendered.

authority.rationale: This component is the sole owner of all shared UI component prop interfaces (CalloutBoxProps, CodeBlockProps, VersionBadgeProps, VideoEmbedProps, SidebarProps, PageLayoutProps) and the CalloutType enum. No other component may redefine these types. RouteEntry/RouteManifest are imported from app_routing and re-exported but NOT owned here.
